title: ClaimCenter: Recover from database deadlock
trigger_condition: When PostgreSQL logs contain 'ERROR: deadlock detected' for ClaimCenter tables (claim, claim_line_item, claim_expense). Triggers when deadlock occurs >3 times in 5 minutes.
steps: 1. Confirm deadlock via: SELECT * FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE query LIKE '%claim%' ORDER BY conflicts DESC LIMIT 5
2. Identify blocking transaction: SELECT pid, usename, state FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state != 'idle'
3. Kill blocking transaction: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) for the offending PID
4. Verify claim table locks cleared: SELECT * FROM pg_locks WHERE relation::regclass::text LIKE '%claim%'
5. Restart ClaimCenter service: systemctl restart claimcenter-api
6. Monitor for recurrence: tail -f /var/log/claimcenter/error.log | grep deadlock

title: IntegrationGateway: Connection pool exhaustion response
trigger_condition: When connection_wait_time_ms > 5000 for >2 consecutive minutes, OR when active_connection_count > 95% of max_pool_size (default: 50). Alert fires via Grafana /d/integration-gateway-health.
steps: 1. Verify alert threshold: curl http://localhost:9090/metrics | grep ig_active_connections
2. Check for stuck connections: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle in transaction'
3. Identify slow/hung queries: SELECT pid, query, backend_start, state_change FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state != 'idle' AND query_start < now() - interval '5 minutes'
4. Terminate idle-in-transaction sessions: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) for pids > 10 minutes old
5. If >80% utilization persists, trigger auto-scaling: kubectl scale deployment integration-gateway --replicas=3
6. Monitor recovery: watch -n 2 'curl http://localhost:9090/metrics | grep ig_active_connections'
7. Post-incident: Review gateway logs for slow integrations, increase query timeouts if needed
